sam: Quick perf note — saw latency tail pop on stream-heavy workloads after the token-bucket change. Profiling attached in thread.
anya: Can you drop numbers? Is this pure streamed requests or mixed?
sam: Mostly streamed chat. 95th went from 220ms -> 420ms for first token under burst. P50 fine. KV cache hit rate unchanged.
dj: Did kernel selection change path for partial-decode? We added pinning to small-kernel for short seqs last week.
sam: Exactly. Kernel pinning + token-bucket batching seems to increase partial-decode queuing. When partial decode waits for batch window it loses priority and then small-kernel threads block.
zu: Repro steps?
sam: Minimal repro: run chat-streamer with --burst=100 --token-bucket=0.5, enable partial-decode; profile with perf counters. I pasted perf snippet:
```
Sched wait: 12.4ms -> 65.1ms
Kernel switch: small->large collisions: 47 per sec
Decode preemptions: 9x
```
anya: Hmm. hypothesis: when tokenbucket drains, admission accepts large batched requests that steal kernel resources, partial-decode tasks get queued; scheduler does not elevate partial-decode priority.
dj: Quick mitigation: bump partial-decode priority in queue policy OR reserve a token budget slice for streams. That avoids batching them into large kernels.
sam: Tried reserve 10% budget for stream-prefetch: 95th improved to 260ms. But throughput down 4% and cost slightly up.
zu: Could we do adaptive: if stream latency > x then raise reservation until back to SLO?
anya: Also consider KV warmup ordering: stream partials often need fresh KV keys; if KV warmup happens after kernel handoff they stall. Maybe prefetch KV for first token when stream starts.
sam: Implemented prefetch hint on open-stream, warmed KV hits up by 12%.
perf-bot: nightly-run: stream-slo-regression detected on main at 2076538000 -> linked issue #2931
dj: Ok next steps: 1) prototyping token-budget reservation + adaptive loop 2) small-queue priority bump for partial-decode 3) KV prefetch hints 4) metric add: kernel-switches-per-stream
zu: I'll take (1) and (3). sam take (2) and (4)?
sam: Yup. I'll open small PR with queue delta and histograms.
anya: Thanks — add experiment flags. Keep canary scoped to dedicated only.
sam: ping @zu when PR lands, will run repro harness.
zu: noted :thumbsup:
